conviction_note: The 'event' is Hot Chili's FY2026 annual report, which is not a profit print for a pre-revenue explorer. Its cash position is already public: A$24.9m at 30 June in the Appendix 5B, and about A$46m at 31 July after the US$15m OR royalty closed, as stated in the 21 Sep presentation. The last two annual reports moved the stock +2.37% and +1.09% the next session. Nothing that is not priced is dated to land inside a window I cannot even confirm the report falls in. So there are no findings and the answer is 0.

filer_type_check: quarterly_report_only. That is confirmed by three years of ASX lodgements: every recurring print is a Quarterly Activities/Appendix 5B, and there is no 4D or 4E. The only lodgement near the vendor's 25 Sep date is the statutory Annual Report, which lands with the 4G, the Corporate Governance Statement and the Mineral Resource & Ore Reserve Statement at 30 June. It was lodged 2024-09-27 at 16:32 and 2025-09-30 at 17:17. So I hunted cash against runway, and anything else datable into the window: the La Verde maiden MRE, the 22 pending drill holes, and the strategic partnering process.
event_check: Not confirmed. The ASX 2026 archive (https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=HCH&timeframe=Y&year=2026), read 2026-09-24, holds no results-date notice and no annual report yet. Its last item is the Precious Metals Summit presentation of 2026-09-21. The 4 Sep 2026 LR 3.13.1 notice gives the AGM (25 Nov 2026) and the director-nomination close (7 Oct) but no reporting date (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260904/pdf/073r9kp7bq4s5q.pdf). The report is statutorily due by 30 Sep. The two prior years landed 27 Sep 2024 at 16:32 (the last business day before the 30th) and 30 Sep 2025 at 17:17, per https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=HCH&timeframe=Y&year=2025 and ...&year=2024. A 2026 lodgement on Tue 29 or Wed 30 Sep would fall outside the 25 Sep close to 28 Sep close window. So the vendor's 25 Sep date is plausible but unverified, and the event is in any case not a profit print.
session_check: amc is consistent with history: both prior annual reports were lodged after the 16:00 close (16:32 and 17:17). Not independently confirmed for 2026. Sources: the ASX 2024 and 2025 archives above.
positioning_check: ASIC aggregate short position 0.268% as of 2026-09-18, down from 0.3175% on 2026-09-11 (-0.05pp, covering). It lags 3 sessions. That is negligible: no squeeze fuel and no crowded short to lean on. The tape matters more. The stock fell about 20% in the week to 15 Sep (1.75 to 1.435) and then recovered +9.46% over 5 sessions to 1.62, while the 20-day run-up reads -5.81%. The move is copper-price and newsflow driven, not print driven. priced_lean_pct +0.55 is small and I have nothing that beats or contradicts it.

outside_window.finding: Maiden La Verde Mineral Resource Estimate. The June-quarter report says it is 'expected to be released later this year', followed by a revised Costa Fuego PFS and an EIA submission in Q2 CY2027. The 21 Sep 2026 presentation lists 'La Verde Maiden MRE 2026' as the upcoming catalyst. The September drill release says assays from 22 holes are still pending, so the MRE is unlikely to be ready by 28 Sep, and the timing and sign cannot be sized.

Asset-level strategic partnering process run by BMO Capital Markets. The June quarter reports 'several new non-binding, indicative, incomplete and conditional proposals' received and ongoing due diligence, including site visits. It is real but undated and uncertain, and nothing places a binding outcome inside the window.

searched_and_found_nothing: ASX 2026 announcement archive, read in full for the last 12 months. There is no trading halt since 1 May 2026 (the price query on 5 May was answered with drill results). There is no results-date notice, no new Appendix 3B/placement since the Feb 2026 A$40m raise, and no substantial-holder notices in 2026.

Cash runway. The June 5B shows A$24.9m and 2.64 quarters, but the US$15m OR royalty (announced 7 Jul 2026, https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260707/pdf/071fy6tx1x0pbc.pdf) closed, taking cash to about A$46m at 31 Jul. So there is no near-term funding overhang for the annual report to surface, and a going-concern emphasis is implausible.

The reaction history on the annual report line: +2.37% (close 27 Sep to close 30 Sep 2024) and +1.09% (close 30 Sep to close 1 Oct 2025), both inside normal daily noise (realised vol about 4% a day). Yahoo chart https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/HCH.AX?range=3y&interval=1d.

Web search for La Verde MRE timing and September 2026 news (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/thick-high-grade-surface-enrichment-zone-extends-at-la-verde-302872194.html, https://wealthawesome.com/whats-going-on-with-hot-chili-ltd-stock-wednesday-09162026-wgo). Neither gives a specific date for the MRE or an explanation of the mid-September 20% drawdown. An unexplained drawdown is worth 0.

Insider trades. The sale of 100k shares by insider J.I. Silva Solari at C$1.49 on 7 Aug 2026 and the MD's buy of 20,958 at C$1.60 on 13 Aug 2026 are small and old (https://wealthawesome.com/hot-chili-ltd-insiders-sold-ca149k-08132026-insider).
baseline_tension: None. I found nothing that agrees or disagrees with the small +0.55 lean or the +9.46% five-day rebound. The annual report is a known-content lodgement, and the real catalysts (the MRE and partnering) are undated and sit outside this window.
